name: dax_same_period_last_year_by_month
expect_sql:
SELECT u.k1 AS year,
       u.k2 AS month,
       MAX(u.s1) AS sales,
       (MAX(u.s2)) AS sales_ly
FROM (
SELECT j1.year AS k1,
       j1.month AS k2,
       SUM(t.amount) AS s1,
       NULL AS s2
FROM   retail.fct_sales t
LEFT JOIN retail.dim_date j1 ON j1.date_key = t.order_date
GROUP BY j1.year, j1.month
  UNION ALL
SELECT c.k1 AS k1,
       c.k2 AS k2,
       NULL AS s1,
       SUM(t.amount) AS s2
FROM   (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.k1, c.k2, s.date_key AS dt
  FROM   (
    SELECT d.year AS k1, d.month AS k2, d.date_key AS dt, LAG(d.date_key) OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.month ORDER BY d.date_key) AS prev
    FROM   retail.dim_date d
  ) c
  JOIN retail.dim_date s ON s.date_key BETWEEN DATEADD(MONTH, -12, c.dt) AND CASE WHEN c.dt = LAST_DAY(c.dt) AND c.prev = DATEADD(DAY, -1, c.dt) THEN LAST_DAY(DATEADD(MONTH, -12, c.dt)) ELSE DATEADD(MONTH, -12, c.dt) END
) c
JOIN retail.fct_sales t ON t.order_date = c.dt
GROUP BY c.k1, c.k2
) u
GROUP BY u.k1, u.k2
